description: Post-flash DSE overlay only. Loaded by post_flash_dse.py (C2HLS_DSE_SKILL_ENTRIES_JSON). Not mixed into flash's 84/90-skill dump. Goal: rewrite a working LCST GEMM nest into compact multi-PE x SIMD-k, not AutoSA PE/IO netlist clone and not pragma-only DSE. PE/SIMD is per-kernel (see hls-dse-pick-pe-simd-for-kernel); 16x4 is only the autosa_mm default.

skills.pattern: dense GEMM/mm after flash LCST still pipelines a k-loop that updates one C[i][j] or crow[j] (DSP ~3-8, II=4 float add recurrence). I,J,K are compile-time constants that fit on-chip.
skills.strategy: Keep the flash load-compute-store ABI. Rewrite only the compute nest into row PEs with latency hiding: tile i by PE (prefer 16 if I%16==0 else 8/4), pipeline the independent j (C-column) loop, fully unroll the PE loop. Each PE owns Crow[p][j]. Do not pipeline k. Do not emit AutoSA kernel0 / PE-IO netlists / hls::stream of PE structs.
required_steps: keep the exact extern C top name, parameter list, array ranks/shapes, and all existing #pragma HLS INTERFACE lines
keep bulk on-chip staging of A, B, and C (load then compute then store); no m_axi RMW inside compute
choose PE/SIMD from the mandatory recipe (autosa_mm default 16x4; autosa_mm_32x8 overlay 32x8; getting_started/intel 32x4; hcl/int16 32x2; catapult 8x4). PE must divide I (or I_P)
allocate private Crow[PE][J]; init from local C rows i0+p
outer i0 += PE; middle k0 += SIMD; innermost pipelined j over 0..J-1
fully UNROLL the PE loop inside the pipelined j loop so PE rows update in parallel
pipeline j at II=1; never put PIPELINE on k or on a parent that still has a non-unrolled child
index B with the existing layout: if B is B[J][K] use local_B[j][k]; if B is B[K][J] use local_B[k][j]
write Crow back to local C then store C; do not change numerical semantics
guards: PE and SIMD must divide I and K; if not, pick smaller factors that do
PIPELINE on j is legal only because PE and SIMD children are fully unrolled
Crow[p][j] dependence across k0 is an outer-loop reduction — that is intended; do not pipeline k0
do not clone AutoSA's 1000+ line PE/IO interconnect; compact nested loops only
do not keep a scalar crow[j] += a*b across k as the compute engine

skills.pattern: k-reduction of float MAC into one C element inside a pipelined loop, causing II=4 (FP add recurrence) and DSP of a few units
skills.strategy: Factor k by SIMD (prefer 4). Fully unroll the SIMD inner loop so Vitis builds an adder tree of independent a[s]*b[s] products, then one add into Crow[p][j]. The pipelined loop stays on independent j, so the Crow update is not a loop-carried FP recurrence of the PIPELINE loop.
required_steps: pick SIMD that divides K (prefer 4, else 8 or 2)
fully UNROLL simd_k; do not PIPELINE simd_k
form partial = a0*b0 + a1*b1 + ... as combinational/unrolled adds, then Crow[p][j] += partial
partition the K dimension of local_A and local_B with cyclic factor=SIMD so the unrolled reads have ports
guards: unrolled SIMD must not sit under a pipelined k loop that still carries one C[i][j]
do not use a scalar float acc across k as the II=1 pipeline body
SIMD>1 with no ARRAY_PARTITION on K will serialize on BRAM ports

skills.pattern: unrolled PE and SIMD loops that read the same on-chip A/B/C buffers without matching ARRAY_PARTITION, causing port conflicts and II inflation
skills.strategy: Partition exactly to the parallel accesses: Crow complete on PE dim; local_A cyclic PE on row dim and cyclic SIMD on K dim; local_B cyclic SIMD on K dim. Do not complete-partition full I x J C (explodes FF). Do not partition m_axi top ports.
required_steps: ARRAY_PARTITION variable=Crow complete dim=1 (PE rows)
ARRAY_PARTITION variable=local_A cyclic factor=PE dim=1 and cyclic factor=SIMD dim=2
ARRAY_PARTITION variable=local_B cyclic factor=SIMD on the K dimension (dim=2 if B is [J][K])
optional: cyclic factor=PE on local_C dim=1 if writeback is unrolled over p
never ARRAY_PARTITION the top-level m_axi arrays
guards: complete partition of Crow[PE][J] is small (PE=16, J=64)
complete partition of local_C[I][J] is usually too large — prefer cyclic PE
partition factor must match UNROLL factor or ports still conflict
skills.template:
#pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=Crow complete dim=1
#pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=local_A cyclic factor=PE dim=1
#pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=local_A cyclic factor=SIMD dim=2
#pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=local_B cyclic factor=SIMD dim=2

skills.pattern: compute_k pipelined or sequential with C[i][j] += a*b, crow[j] += a*b, or UNROLL-on-j while k remains the reduction loop (DSP stays ~3-8, II=4 on float add)
skills.strategy: Reject k-loop recurrence on a single C element as the DSE result. That is the flash kernel, not DSE. Move PIPELINE to independent j, unroll PE rows, and reduce k with an unrolled SIMD adder tree. If DSP is still single-digit, revise before submitting.
required_steps: scan the compute nest: if the pipelined loop's body writes one C[i][j] or crow[j] carried from k, reject
rewrite so the pipelined loop is j (or a latency-hiding tile over independent C columns)
confirm PE UNROLL and SIMD UNROLL are present
confirm DSP after csynth is >> 8 (expect ~PE*SIMD*5 for float)
guards: UNROLL 8 on j with still-sequential k is not multi-PE DSE
DATAFLOW without PE tiling does not fix the k recurrence
pragma-only ARRAY_PARTITION on the flash nest will not raise DSP

skills.pattern: 64^3 dense GEMM whose rank1 DSP is not 320, or whose header uses I_P/J_P/K_P or integer data_t. Blind PE=16 SIMD=4 misses getting_started/intel (640 DSP, ~2194/4178 cycles) and uses the wrong macros on catapult.
skills.strategy: Read kernel.h and the mandatory PE recipe. Set #define PE and SIMD to that recipe. Use I_P/J_P/K_P when those macros exist. Integer data_t accumulates in data_t, not float. Expected DSP is PE*SIMD*5 for float, PE*SIMD for uint16, ~PE*SIMD*3 for uint32. 16x4 is correct only for autosa_mm / mm_hcl_intel.
required_steps: copy PE_NUM/SIMD from the recipe block in the user prompt (not from the autosa_mm template if they differ)
autosa_mm_getting_started and autosa_mm_intel: PE=32 SIMD=4, expect DSP~640
autosa_mm_hcl: PE=32 SIMD=2, expect DSP~320
autosa_mm_int16: PE=32 SIMD=2 on unsigned short, expect DSP~64; no 0.0f
autosa_mm_catapult: PE=8 SIMD=4 on unsigned int; loops use I_P/J_P/K_P
autosa_mm and autosa_mm_hcl_intel: keep PE=16 SIMD=4
autosa_mm_32x8 overlay (C2HLS_PE_RECIPE): PE=32 SIMD=8, expect DSP~1280, pack ap_uint<256>
if seed INTERFACE is bundle=gmem on A/B/C, split to gmem0/gmem1/gmem2
guards: PE=16 SIMD=4 on getting_started/intel leaves DSP~320 and ~12k cycles vs rank1 2194/4178
using I/J/K on catapult does not compile
float union pack on unsigned short corrupts csim
stream MIN_DSP=200 would reject a correct int16/catapult kernel — DSE min DSP follows the recipe
